# gitmoap_group_branch_rules (Data Source)

List branch rules for a group. The rules the group declares itself, not those of the groups above it. Anyone who can see the group may call it.

The token needs `branch_rule:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_branch_rules" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

- `branch_pattern` (String)
- `branch_rule_id` (String)
- `enforcement` (String) Whether the scopes beneath may replace a rule, or only strengthen it.
- `group_id` (String)
- `merge_allowlist` (List of String)
- `push_allowlist` (List of String)
- `require_code_owner_approval` (Boolean)
